title: A-Road Verification Record
description: The one shared record shape every country's adapter must translate its own data into. This is the entire interoperability contract — nothing else is shared between countries.

recordId.description: Reference number a verifier queries by, e.g. MER-DIP-1001

credentialType.description: One shared protocol, three record types — the point of the demo

holderIdentifier.description: National ID, business ID, or civil registry number — meaning depends on credentialType

issuingCountry.description: ISO-style country code, e.g. MER, KES

lastConfirmed.description: Set by the exchange layer at query time, not stored by the registry

signature.description: HMAC signature over the response, proving it came from the issuing country's adapter
